issue.title: Bug: ACL tests failures on new DRH topo due to attempting to bind ACLs on invalid interfaces (members of PortChannels)

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

`acl/test_acl.py` is failing at setup on new DRH topologies, as the test is attempting to bind ACLs to interfaces that are members of PortChannels. It should only attempt to bind to PortChannels or interfaces that are not members of PortChannels.

### Steps to Reproduce

Running on a switch where all interfaces are members of PortChannels (e.g. new urh_min/lrh_min topologies).

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test should automatically filter for valid PortChannels and interfaces to bind to.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
`acl/test_acl.py` was failing due to the test attempting to bind ACLs to interfaces that are members of PortChannels. Add logic to ensure we filter for valid PortChannels/interfaces (non portchannel members)
#### How did you do it?
Add logic in setup to filter only valid PC/Interfaces are in `acl_table_ports`
#### How did you verify/test it?
Run test on DRH topo where all interfaces are part of a PortChannel where it was consistently failing, ensure it passed.

DRH topologies
